_meta.note: The five portable questions. No domain vocabulary, so a profile of an SRE agent and a profile of a coding agent stay comparable on these five even though their phase vocabularies differ. Frozen: changing any wording here invalidates comparison with earlier runs.

hypothesis_driven.instructions: Is this step testing one specific suspicion, as opposed to gathering material in general? A step that would look the same whatever the fault turned out to be is not testing a suspicion.

new_information.instructions: Did this step's result reveal something that the earlier steps listed under prior_actions had not already established? If the result only confirms what was already visible, answer no.

revisits.instructions: Does this step re-examine something that an earlier step under prior_actions already examined?

changes_system.instructions: Does this step modify the system, as opposed to only reading from it?

targeting.instructions: How narrowly targeted is this step?
criteria: Applies to the whole system with no particular target.
Aimed at one broad area of the system.
Aimed at a handful of specific objects.
Aimed at one specific property of one specific object.
